collection.description: A young villager explains that neither man nor woman describes them, and wants a place in village life.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A young villager explains that neither 'man' nor 'woman' feels like the right description of them. They want a place in village life without becoming a spectacle.

choices.label: Ask what words and role they prefer
Invite them to shape a new custom
Let them live without a public declaration

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The villager shares a name and form of address; some neighbors need practice, but they make an effort.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: A welcoming ceremony recognizes people as they describe themselves; others choose not to participate, respectfully.

c__fx.name: Answer C
c__fx.text: Their wishes are quietly honored. They continue working, laughing, and arguing like anyone else.

c__text.name: Answer C
c__text.text: Their wishes are quietly honored. They continue working, laughing, and arguing like anyone else.
